title: FB-008 preserve converted SRT sidecar provenance
summary: Preserve source/conversion provenance when MP4 compatibility selects one external converted SRT sidecar.
reason: Worker finding FR-015 identified that MP4 converted-SRT sidecar selection collapses ASS, BDPGS, VobSub, and TX3G candidates into a TX3G-shaped publish record, obscuring the selected sidecar's real source kind.
behavior_before: MP4 compatibility returned the selected converted SRT sidecar only through Tx3gTracks, and sidecar records did not expose whether the SRT came from ASS, TX3G, BDPGS, or VobSub conversion.
behavior_after: Converted SRT sidecar candidates carry source/conversion provenance. MP4 compatibility exposes the selected candidate through a source-neutral field while preserving the legacy Tx3gTracks handoff. Publish records include source_subtitle_kind, source_subtitle_codec, source_kind, and conversion_kind, and generated SRT names use the selected sidecar's source kind.
tests_added: PowerShell regression coverage for MP4 selected converted-SRT sidecar provenance and sidecar manifest record provenance.
manual_validation: Bundled Python: mediapipeline.tools.change_control.validate_changes --require-worktree-coverage failed only for unrelated uncovered dirty files docs/implementation/encoder-breadth-av1-plan.md and docs/reviews/function-module-audit-2026-06-11/workers/worker-08-webview-pages.md.
rollback_plan: Revert the subtitle sidecar provenance metadata and test updates, then rerun focused subtitle builder and sidecar publish validation.
notes: Subtitle/media behavior boundary change. Representative real-media validation was not run in this environment and remains required before shipping subtitle behavior.
